pos.personaBrief: Telê wanted his side to hold the ball (Menotti's '60% with the ball', 1982; São Paulo 'alta posse', 4-2-2-2) and attack when in possession, though he sat deeper once v Bragantino 1991.

pro.personaBrief: He rejected long balls and kicking aimlessly (Roda Viva 1992) and sterile backward passing (Folha 1994), wanting short technical football with forward intent; Atlético 1971 was fast and aggressive.

est.personaBrief: He admired Holland 74 with everyone moving and swapping positions, gave 1982 players freedom, and rotated Cafu, Müller, Leonardo; Falcão: 'intuitively, not systematically'.

lar.personaBrief: Telê was a winger himself; Atlético's Tião had a surgical cross, full-backs pushed to attack, and the 1982 absence of a right winger was seen as the tactical flaw; he also looked for play through the middle against closed defences.

blo.personaBrief: He demanded all players, stars included, win the ball back like Cruyff (1992); Palmeiras had strong marking and Zico said whoever was nearest closed down; he did not defend deep by philosophy.

mar.personaBrief: No source states zonal or man marking; inferred from collective ball-oriented closing down (Zico 1982) and his general lack of fixed tasks, leaning zonal.

pla.personaBrief: Mostly imposed his philosophy ('prefers strengthening his own team', attacked Italy 1982), with pragmatic exceptions like sitting back v Bragantino 1991 and three volantes in 1993.

res.personaBrief: He called the beautiful-vs-winning dilemma a 'balela', wanting good football and victory, and said an ugly win does not satisfy him; 1982 and 'futebol-audácia' show spectacle as purpose.

sis.personaBrief: He gave stars freedom (1982 Zico, Falcão) but demanded Raí tackle and work and cut the indisciplined; technique first, with collective effort expected from all.

jog.personaBrief: 'Primeiro é o técnico': daily fundamentals training, no central midfielders who only destroy; yet in the 1990s he required stars to fight for the ball.

bas.personaBrief: At São Paulo he promoted Cafu, Leonardo, Antônio Carlos, Elivelton and the Expressinho, though Grêmio 1977 was only experienced players and he mixed veterans with youth.

lid.personaBrief: 'Eu sou duro', 'não admito indisciplina', cut Renato Gaúcho and Jorge Mendonça threatened; yet he consulted senior players before the 1991 final and was conciliatory at Atlético 1971.
